title: Microtexture gap audit and controlled finishing experiments 20260910
body: CONFIRMED static inspection: current restore_inference_region resizes only on output-geometry mismatch and writes RGB lossless; composite_masked adds no blur but encodes YUV420 CRF16; ProPainter adapter has separate legacy MP4 and opt-in PNG/padding preserve-pixels routes. Existing subtitle_finish sharpening requires correlated detail deficit outside the mask and may intentionally remain inactive after exterior source compositing. HYPOTHESIS: avoidable resampling and intermediate codecs may explain some perceived texture gap, but historical v3 stage artifacts are required for attribution. Prioritized controlled experiments: matching per scene on clean image content; lossless stage captures; source identity resize/codec controls; existing native preservation route; bounded luma finishing; temporal donor/model restoration only if needed. LPIPS/SSIM against subtitle-covered source interior do not establish restored-background fidelity. RealBasicVSR phase4 has no accepted real-video candidate; do not count as proven quality failure/success. Full sourced report research/experiments/MICROTEXTURE-RESEARCH-20260910.md. No GPU or production changes.
